name: IHL - LeadMailbox Intake to GHL Contact

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, skipped: true, reason: $json.reason, leadid: $json.leadid }) }}

parameters.content:
## IHL - LeadMailbox INTAKE -> GHL contact

LeadMailbox Service POSTs a new lead here; this upserts a GHL contact in the
Independent Lending subaccount with the LMB lead id in the dedicated field
(contact.leadid_leadmailbox), so the disposition write-back can find it later.

SETUP:
1) LMB Settings -> Services -> add a Server/HTTP service (Status Trigger = the
   status your new leads enter, e.g. Future Contact). POST JSON to this webhook.
   Send these keys (LMB #{...} tokens): leadid=#{LeadID}, firstname=#{First Name},
   lastname=#{Last Name}, phone=#{Phone}, email=#{Email}, campaign=#{Campaign}
   (+ any loan fields: loan_purpose, loan_amount, property_value, etc.).
2) GHL Upsert node: set Authentication = Header Auth credential with
   Name 'Authorization', Value 'Bearer <GHL Private Integration Token>'.
   (Token is the pit-... value; store as credential, never hardcode. ROTATE it.)
3) Activate the workflow and fire a test lead from LMB to confirm payload keys.
